system.name: GraphPipe
system.one_liner: a distributed training system that exploits graph pipeline parallelism (GPP) to partition and schedule DNN training across devices

components.name: DNN Computation Graph
components.role: input DAG describing the model's operators and dependencies

components.name: Device Cluster
components.role: input topology of assigned GPU devices

components.name: Pipeline Stage Partitioner (Sec 5)
components.role: partitions the DNN graph into pipeline stages using series/parallel decomposition, device assignment, and micro-batch adjustment

components.name: Model Partitioning
components.role: decomposes the DNN graph via series and parallel decomposition into candidate partitions

components.name: Series Decomposition
components.role: splits the graph into sequential sub-parts

components.name: Parallel Decomposition
components.role: splits the graph into concurrently executable sub-parts

components.name: Device Assignment
components.role: assigns partitioned graph segments to devices/stages (S1-S5)

components.name: Micro-batch Adjustment
components.role: adjusts micro-batch sizes per stage after device assignment

components.name: Static Micro-batch Scheduler (Sec 6)
components.role: computes an optimized micro-batch schedule given the partition, respecting device memory limits

components.name: Memory Usage
components.role: panel showing per-stage memory usage against the device memory limit

components.name: Device Memory Limit
components.role: threshold (OOM boundary) that the schedule must not exceed

components.name: Stages
components.role: ordered pipeline stages (S1-S5) produced by the partitioner

components.name: Pipeline Schedule
components.role: panel showing the resulting forward/backward pass schedule across stages

components.name: Forward Passes
components.role: forward-pass execution blocks in the pipeline schedule

components.name: Backward Passes
components.role: backward-pass execution blocks in the pipeline schedule

components.name: Distributed Runtime
components.role: executes the optimized GPP training strategy (stage partition and micro-batch schedule)

flows.what: model partition, device assignment, micro-batch sizes
optimized GPP training strategy (stage partition, micro-batch schedule)

content.key_idea: GraphPipe takes a DNN graph, mini-batch size, and device topology, and jointly searches stage partitions and micro-batch schedules (respecting device memory limits) to produce a GPP training strategy for the distributed runtime.
content.reading_order: Top-down: Input panel, into the boxed GraphPipe region (Pipeline Stage Partitioner above, Static Micro-batch Scheduler below, connected by bidirectional arrows), down to the Distributed Runtime box.

evidence: Figure 3 illustrates an overview of GraphPipe, a system that accelerates distributed DNN training at scale using GPP.
GraphPipe includes three key components: a pipeline stage partitioner, a static micro-batch scheduler, and a distributed runtime.
Taking as input (a) the computation graph of a DNN, (b) mini-batch size, and (c) the topology of assigned GPUs

summary: This figure gives a top-down overview of GraphPipe, a distributed DNN training system based on graph pipeline parallelism (GPP). It takes as input a DNN computation graph, a mini-batch size, and a device cluster topology. Inside the GraphPipe box, a Pipeline Stage Partitioner (Sec 5) performs model partitioning (series and parallel decomposition of the DAG), device assignment into stages S1-S5, and micro-batch adjustment; it exchanges information bidirectionally with a Static Micro-batch Scheduler (Sec 6), which balances memory usage against a device memory limit (avoiding OOM) and produces a forward/backward-pass pipeline schedule. The resulting optimized GPP training strategy (stage partition plus micro-batch schedule) is handed to a Distributed Runtime for execution. The figure uses nested boxes, small inline diagrams (graph decompositions, memory bars, schedule blocks), and red dashed lines to mark partition cuts and the memory limit.
summary_zh: 该图展示 GraphPipe 系统概览：输入 DNN 计算图、mini-batch 大小与设备集群拓扑后，流水线阶段划分器与静态 micro-batch 调度器双向交互，兼顾设备显存限制生成优化的 GPP 训练策略，交由分布式运行时执行。
